description: Puffin Colony's hooks, the ones `colony hooks install` writes

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/colony/hooks/wait_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if python3 -V >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$f"; elif python -V >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "$f"; else exec py -3 "$f"; fi
[ -n "$COLONY_SESSION" ] && command -v colony >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && exec colony hooks asking
[ -n "$COLONY_SESSION" ] && command -v colony >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && exec colony hooks stopped
[ -n "$COLONY_SESSION" ] && command -v colony >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && colony hooks unread; exit 0
[ -n "$COLONY_SESSION" ] && command -v colony >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && colony hooks unread; exit 0
